lessons.title: The Bridge That Was Rebuilt
lessons.context: A story about a historic bridge, using passive voice throughout.

paragraphs.de: Diese Brücke wurde vor über hundert Jahren gebaut.
paragraphs.en: This bridge was built over a hundred years ago.

paragraphs.de: Während des Krieges wurde sie fast vollständig zerstört.
paragraphs.en: During the war, it was almost completely destroyed.

paragraphs.de: Nachdem der Krieg vorbei war, wurde sie mit großem Aufwand wiederaufgebaut.
paragraphs.en: After the war was over, it was rebuilt with great effort.

paragraphs.de: Heute wird sie von Tausenden Menschen jeden Tag überquert.
paragraphs.en: Today it is crossed by thousands of people every day.

paragraphs.de: Sie wird auch in Zukunft weiter renoviert werden, damit sie noch viele Jahre stehen bleibt.
paragraphs.en: It will continue to be renovated in the future so that it will stand for many more years.

questions.question: When was the bridge originally built?
What happened to the bridge during the war?
What happened after the war?
options: It was rebuilt with great effort

questions.question: What will happen to the bridge in the future?
options: It will continue to be renovated

lessons.title: What He Told the Committee
lessons.context: A workplace story using indirect speech and Futur I.

paragraphs.de: Der Manager sagte, dass das Unternehmen im nächsten Jahr wachsen wird.
paragraphs.en: The manager said that the company will grow next year.

paragraphs.de: Er erklärte, dass neue Mitarbeiter eingestellt werden müssen.
paragraphs.en: He explained that new employees need to be hired.

paragraphs.de: Jemand fragte, ob die Gehälter auch erhöht werden.
paragraphs.en: Someone asked whether salaries will also be increased.

paragraphs.de: Der Manager antwortete, dass das noch entschieden werden muss.
paragraphs.en: The manager answered that this still needs to be decided.

paragraphs.de: Nachdem die Sitzung beendet war, sprachen alle Mitarbeiter darüber, was gesagt worden war.
paragraphs.en: After the meeting was over, all the employees talked about what had been said.

questions.question: What did the manager say about next year?
What did he say needs to happen?
options: New employees need to be hired

questions.question: What was the manager's answer about salaries?
options: It still needs to be decided

questions.question: What did employees do after the meeting?
options: Talked about what had been said

lessons.title: When the Lights Went Out
lessons.context: A narrative distinguishing als, wenn, and während.

paragraphs.de: Als der Sturm über die Stadt zog, gingen plötzlich alle Lichter aus.
paragraphs.en: When the storm swept over the city, all the lights suddenly went out.

paragraphs.de: Während wir im Dunkeln saßen, erzählten wir uns Geschichten bei Kerzenlicht.
paragraphs.en: While we sat in the dark, we told each other stories by candlelight.

paragraphs.de: Wenn so etwas passiert, wird mir immer bewusst, wie wichtig Strom für uns ist.
paragraphs.en: Whenever something like that happens, I always become aware of how important electricity is for us.

paragraphs.de: Nachdem der Sturm vorbei war, kam der Strom nach ein paar Stunden zurück.
paragraphs.en: After the storm was over, the power came back after a few hours.

paragraphs.de: Als das Licht wieder anging, klatschten alle vor Freude.
paragraphs.en: When the light came back on, everyone clapped with joy.

questions.question: What happened when the storm swept over the city?
What did they do while sitting in the dark?
When does the writer become aware of electricity's importance?
What happened when the light came back on?

lessons.title: Before the Interview
lessons.context: A story built around bevor/nachdem sequencing.

paragraphs.de: Bevor sie zum Vorstellungsgespräch ging, bereitete sie sich sehr gründlich vor.
paragraphs.en: Before she went to the interview, she prepared very thoroughly.

paragraphs.de: Nachdem sie alle möglichen Fragen geübt hatte, fühlte sie sich viel sicherer.
paragraphs.en: After she had practiced all possible questions, she felt much more confident.

paragraphs.de: Bevor das Gespräch begann, war sie trotzdem noch etwas nervös.
paragraphs.en: Before the interview began, she was still a bit nervous.

paragraphs.de: Nachdem das Gespräch beendet war, wusste sie, dass es gut gelaufen war.
paragraphs.en: After the interview was over, she knew it had gone well.

paragraphs.de: Eine Woche später, nachdem sie lange gewartet hatte, bekam sie endlich die gute Nachricht.
paragraphs.en: A week later, after she had waited a long time, she finally got the good news.

questions.question: What did she do before the interview?
How did she feel after practicing?
Was she nervous before the interview began?
What happened a week later?

paragraphs.de: Woran denkst du gerade, fragte sie ihn.
paragraphs.en: What are you thinking about right now, she asked him.

paragraphs.de: Er antwortete, dass er an seine Zukunft dachte und sich Sorgen darüber machte.
paragraphs.en: He answered that he was thinking about his future and was worried about it.

paragraphs.de: Sie fragte, wovor er genau Angst hatte.
paragraphs.en: She asked what exactly he was afraid of.

paragraphs.de: Er sagte, dass er sich davor fürchtete, die falsche Entscheidung zu treffen.
paragraphs.en: He said that he was afraid of making the wrong decision.

paragraphs.de: Sie erklärte ihm, dass niemand perfekte Entscheidungen trifft, und dass er sich darauf verlassen könne, dass sie immer für ihn da sei.
paragraphs.en: She explained to him that no one makes perfect decisions, and that he could rely on her always being there for him.

questions.question: What was he thinking about?
What was he afraid of?
What did she tell him about decisions?
What did she promise him?
options: To always be there for him

lessons.title: Rules of the House
lessons.context: A short text using modal passive constructions.

paragraphs.de: In diesem Gebäude müssen bestimmte Regeln befolgt werden.
paragraphs.en: In this building, certain rules must be followed.

paragraphs.de: Zwischen 22 und 7 Uhr darf keine laute Musik gespielt werden.
paragraphs.en: Between 10 PM and 7 AM, no loud music may be played.

paragraphs.de: Der Müll muss jeden Mittwoch nach draußen gebracht werden.
paragraphs.en: The trash must be taken outside every Wednesday.

paragraphs.de: Probleme sollten immer direkt mit dem Hausmeister besprochen werden.
paragraphs.en: Problems should always be discussed directly with the caretaker.

paragraphs.de: Wenn diese Regeln nicht respektiert werden, kann es zu Konflikten mit den Nachbarn kommen.
paragraphs.en: If these rules are not respected, it can lead to conflicts with the neighbors.

questions.question: What must be followed in this building?
When may loud music not be played?
When must the trash be taken out?
What happens if the rules aren't respected?
options: It can lead to conflicts with neighbors

lessons.title: A Village's Future
lessons.context: A text combining Futur I and passive voice about community planning.

paragraphs.de: Dieses kleine Dorf wird sich in den nächsten Jahren stark verändern.
paragraphs.en: This small village will change a lot in the coming years.

paragraphs.de: Neue Straßen werden gebaut, und alte Gebäude werden renoviert.
paragraphs.en: New roads will be built, and old buildings will be renovated.

paragraphs.de: Die Bewohner wurden gefragt, was sie sich für ihr Dorf wünschen.
paragraphs.en: The residents were asked what they wish for their village.

paragraphs.de: Viele sagten, dass ihnen die Natur wichtiger ist als schnelles Wachstum.
paragraphs.en: Many said that nature is more important to them than fast growth.

paragraphs.de: Deshalb wird ein Plan entwickelt, damit das Dorf modern wird, ohne seinen Charakter zu verlieren.
paragraphs.en: That's why a plan is being developed so that the village becomes modern without losing its character.

questions.question: What will happen to the village in the coming years?
What did residents say is more important than fast growth?
What are the residents being asked?
options: What they wish for their village

questions.question: What is the goal of the plan being developed?
options: To make it a big city

lessons.title: The Discovery
lessons.context: A short narrative about a historical find, using past passive.

paragraphs.de: Vor zwei Jahren wurde in diesem Feld eine alte Münze gefunden.
paragraphs.en: Two years ago, an old coin was found in this field.

paragraphs.de: Nachdem Experten sie untersucht hatten, wurde festgestellt, dass sie über tausend Jahre alt war.
paragraphs.en: After experts had examined it, it was determined that it was over a thousand years old.

paragraphs.de: Die Nachricht wurde schnell in der ganzen Region verbreitet.
paragraphs.en: The news was quickly spread throughout the whole region.

paragraphs.de: Woran erkannten die Experten, dass die Münze echt war?
paragraphs.en: How did the experts recognize that the coin was genuine?

paragraphs.de: Sie erklärten, dass das Material und die Symbole darauf eindeutig auf diese Zeit hinwiesen.
paragraphs.en: They explained that the material and the symbols on it clearly pointed to that time period.

questions.question: What was found in the field two years ago?
How old was the coin determined to be?
What happened to the news of the discovery?
options: It spread quickly through the region

questions.question: How did the experts know the coin was genuine?
options: The material and symbols pointed to that era

lessons.title: A Promise Kept
lessons.context: A story using bevor/nachdem and Futur I about a personal commitment.

paragraphs.de: Bevor er die Stadt verließ, versprach er, dass er zurückkommen würde.
paragraphs.en: Before he left the city, he promised that he would come back.

paragraphs.de: Nachdem viele Jahre vergangen waren, hielt er endlich sein Versprechen.
paragraphs.en: After many years had passed, he finally kept his promise.

paragraphs.de: Als er zurückkam, wurde er von seiner ganzen Familie herzlich empfangen.
paragraphs.en: When he came back, he was warmly welcomed by his whole family.

paragraphs.de: Er sagte, dass er nie vergessen hatte, woher er kam.
paragraphs.en: He said that he had never forgotten where he came from.

paragraphs.de: Nachdem er wieder da war, entschied er sich, für immer zu bleiben.
paragraphs.en: After he was back, he decided to stay forever.

questions.question: What did he promise before leaving the city?
How long did it take him to keep his promise?
How was he received when he came back?
What did he decide after returning?

lessons.title: Reflections on Change
lessons.context: A capstone reflection combining B1+'s full grammar range.

paragraphs.de: Vieles in unserem Leben wird sich verändern, ob wir es wollen oder nicht.
paragraphs.en: Many things in our lives will change, whether we want them to or not.

paragraphs.de: Als ich jünger war, hatte ich Angst davor, aber jetzt sehe ich es anders.
paragraphs.en: When I was younger, I was afraid of it, but now I see it differently.

paragraphs.de: Nachdem ich viele Veränderungen erlebt hatte, wurde mir klar, dass sie oft etwas Gutes bringen.
paragraphs.en: After I had experienced many changes, it became clear to me that they often bring something good.

paragraphs.de: Wenn man sich darauf konzentriert, was gelernt werden kann, wird jede Veränderung leichter.
paragraphs.en: If you focus on what can be learned, every change becomes easier.

paragraphs.de: Worauf ich mich heute am meisten freue, ist zu sehen, was als Nächstes kommen wird.
paragraphs.en: What I look forward to most today is seeing what will come next.

questions.question: What does the writer say about change?
options: It will happen whether we want it or not

questions.question: How did the writer feel about change when younger?
What became clear to the writer after experiencing many changes?
options: That change often brings something good

questions.question: What does the writer look forward to most today?
